name: PF1_holdout_rule
decision: operator: keep the frozen pick (frozen/PF1_pick.json, commit f4658ec) unchanged; conservative holdout amendment registered before 2026-12-05 and before any holdout data is opened
pick: unchanged: th 6c, L 0, timing a, M 1c, Lighter view lag 120 ms, PM hold 320, unwind sell, q5, competitor term on
criteria: from frozen/PF1_plan.json holdout_pass_all: c/share per attempted share >= +2.0 including unwinds; 90% lower bound of $/day > 0; >= 100 attempts; >= 5 of 7 days positive

pass_requires_both.as_is: all attempts of the pick, as the frozen model scores them
pass_requires_both.clean_books: only attempts whose Polymarket book in force at the entry match is <= 2000 ms old (match exchange time - exchange time of the last Dublin book row); other attempts are removed; windows, days and the window bootstrap (4000, seed 0) are unchanged, so windows with only stale attempts count as $0

PASS: both as_is and clean_books meet every criterion; otherwise FAIL
report_alongside: book-age diagnostic: p50/p90/p99 of book age at match; attempts and $ on books > 1 / 2 / 5 s old
book_age_scope: entry match only (unwind sells are not filtered)
code: pf1/holdout_eval.py (with pf1/stale_diag.ages, pf1/agg.table) in the commit adding this file; dry-run on validation days only reproduces the report (clean +0.37 c/sh)
usage: python -I pf1/holdout_eval.py --days 2026-11-28 ... 2026-12-04 --out reports/dublin/pf1/holdout_verdict.json (after run_days.sh on the holdout days, on/after 2026-12-05, after the Lighter re-export)
